cues: Humidity raises the speed a little.
A water molecule has a molar mass of eighteen, while dry air averages about twenty nine.
At the same pressure and temperature, water vapour replaces some of the heavier nitrogen and oxygen molecules.
So moist air is less dense, and sound travels slightly faster.
That is one reason distant sounds carry so well in the heavy air before a monsoon shower.
